sections.title: Hidden Classrooms
items: The 'Show hidden classes (#)' button has been removed, being replaced with a folder accessible from the top of the homepage
This should make your home page look cleaner, while still keeping these classrooms accessible

sections.title: Import/Export
items: While the cloud sync feature works well, it is relient on your browser being signed into the same google account
In cases where this is not possible or not convenient, a new import/export system is acessible through settings.
Clicking the export button downloads a file containing all of your customisations, including things such as the timetable, sidebar icons, classroom nicknames, etc.
You can then take this file, and import it via the import button to restore everything to how you want it to be (Or share yours with friends!)
-- Please create a bug report if this feature is not working as expected

sections.title: Tutorial Visual Refresh
items: The aesthetics of the tutorial/guide found in settings has been refreshed to feel more modern and intuitive
Please provide any feedback on this, as it is a continual effort to make it feel welcoming and easy to use.

sections.title: Other minor changes
items: - The new home page settings panel, accessible through the adjustments icon to the left of your folders, has been moved back in with the widget appearance toggle for a cleaner, less cluttered menu bar
- The timetable panel now fills more of your screen to make it easier to make adjustments
- The list of your saved assignments has been simplified, where you are now able to edit the saved title instead of adding a note underneath

sections.title: Closing Notes
items: Please report any bugs or request changes through the 'Feedback' button in the settings. Thank you for using Modern Classroom!
